description: Expands the Benjolin Oscillator with a rungler CV output you weight bit by bit; place it immediately to the right of the oscillator, or in an unbroken chain of expanders running right from it

params.text: On, the bit knobs snap to 0, 1, 2, 4 and so on to 128; off, they take any value in between
Sets the weight this rungler bit contributes, 0 to 128; the weights of the bits that are high are summed and divided by the total of all eight, so a bit set to 0 drops out of the conversion
Scales the peak to peak swing of the output, 0-10V, centred on 0V before the offset is added; the default is 10V
Shifts the output by -10V to 10V, applied after the range

outputs.text: The converted rungler voltage, stepping each time the rungler is clocked

notes: the output is computed at the sample rate, so oversampling on the Benjolin Oscillator does not reach it
the output rests at the OFFSET voltage until at least one bit value knob is raised above 0, because the weights of the high bits are divided by the total of all eight
menu: Preset — five factory presets set the eight bit knobs at once: 16 Values A, 16 Values B, 16 Values C, 16 Values D and 256 Values
